name: North Chennai Thermal Power Station Stage I
aliases: North Chennai Thermal Power Station – I

units.make: BHEL (boiler BHEL Trichy; turbine KWU design by BHEL; generator BHEL Haridwar)

route: conveyor/rail: port -> plant (unloaders 2x2000 TPH); 22 km rail siding via Athipattu Pudhunagar

water.source: Bay of Bengal (sea water); raw water 3.5 MLD from CMWSSB

emissions.notes: DGR row 'NORTH CHENNAI TPS' (1830 MW, Aug-Nov 2025) is Stage I + Stage II combined; split by capacity when joining.

history: Built with ADB funding (Rs 1792 cr) at Athipattu near Ennore; 3x210 MW commissioned 1994-96. Ash dyke primary 115 ha + secondary 15.5 ha (capacity 40 LMT); plant area 549 acres. The Ennore SEZ project is being built on part of the Stage I ash dyke.
